name: Jeff Yan
why: Cropped from the Higdon and Yan campaign advertisement the ticket bought in the Herald on election day, 18 April 1995, p. 6. It is a posed two-shot against a brick wall, both looking at the camera and smiling, and it is far the best frame of him anywhere: the page scan is 2091 pixels wide and his head and shoulders fill 390 by 530 of it, sharp and evenly lit, in a suit and tie. The identification is structural and leaves no room: the advertisement is headed "Vote Higdon and Yan" above the photograph and "SGA President and Vice-President" below it, the frame holds exactly one woman and one man, and the Herald's own election coverage in the same issue makes Tara Higdon a Slaughters junior and the sitting SGA vice president, and her running mate "Jeffrey Yan, a sophomore from Evansville, Ind." He is therefore the man on the right. Checked against the archive's published 1993-94 Tara Higdon portrait, which is the same dark curly-haired woman as the figure on the left. CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY a week earlier: the Herald of 11 April 1995, p. 3, runs a HIGDON/YAN box with two labelled studio portraits, each name block level with its own frame - "Tara Higdon, Slaughters junior" above "Jeffrey Yan, junior from Evansville, Ind., Previous SGA experience: vice chairman of campus improvements committee" - and the man in the lower frame is the same man as the one on the right of the advertisement. That box was not used as the published crop because it is smaller, about 180 by 250 pixels, and much harsher in tone.

name: Jeffery L. Yan
why: THE SAME CROP AS 1995-96-jeff-yan.jpg, FILED TWICE ON PURPOSE. The archive carries Jeffery L. Yan (Soph. Off Campus Rep, 1994-95) and Jeff Yan (Vice President 1995-96, Judicial Council Foreman 1996-97) as two rows, and they are almost certainly one man. The Herald of 18 April 1995 calls the vice-presidential candidate "Jeffrey Yan, a sophomore from Evansville, Ind." who "has been involved in SGA for two years": a sophomore in 1994-95 is exactly the Soph. Off Campus Rep row, and two years of SGA by April 1995 covers 1993-94 and 1994-95. The Herald of 20 February 1997 then calls him "SAE President Jeff Yan, a senior from Evansville, Ind.", the same home town three years on. Following the archive's rule to flag rather than merge, and the precedent set for Elizabeth White and Lizzy White, the one face is filed under both rows so the duplication stays visible to the editor. If the two rows are merged, this file should be deleted and the 1995-96 one kept. The face itself is proved by the advertisement; it is the PERSON, that is whether the two rows are one man, that is inferred and is left to the editor. CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY a week earlier: the Herald of 11 April 1995, p. 3, runs a HIGDON/YAN box with two labelled studio portraits, each name block level with its own frame - "Tara Higdon, Slaughters junior" above "Jeffrey Yan, junior from Evansville, Ind., Previous SGA experience: vice chairman of campus improvements committee" - and the man in the lower frame is the same man as the one on the right of the advertisement. That box was not used as the published crop because it is smaller, about 180 by 250 pixels, and much harsher in tone.
